name: kumosite-monorepo
description: kumo — site (apps/site), agent (apps/agent), shared types/constants (packages/shared), contracts (contracts/)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n agent,site -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/agent" "cross-env VITE_KUMO_API=http://localhost:8787 npm run dev -w apps/site"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n agent,site -c green,cyan "npm run dev:mock -w apps/agent" "cross-env VITE_KUMO_API=http://localhost:8787 npm run dev -w apps/site"
scripts.build:agent: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/agent
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:staking && npm run test:twitter
scripts.test:twitter: npx -w apps/agent tsx src/twitter/guardrails.test.ts && npx -w apps/agent tsx src/twitter/pipeline.test.ts
